title: ManaMod Nixsas
description: Requires Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric API 1.21.1 and Fabric Installer of version. Mana System added, Ice/Lava Mana Upgrade, Swords, Armor, Bar's, Main R ability that enables you to walk on water or lava, special Sword ability's and much more, join discord.
body:
Mana Mod v1.0.2
This is just a first version of the mod, if you would like to give me some ideas join my discord!


!! Required!!
Minecraft version: 1.21.1
Fabric loader of version 1.21.1
Fabric API: 1.21.1

Mana system

* 5 mana hearths
* R ability 
* Regeneration 0.5 hearths per 1 sec
* Ability by pressing key R - Activable by obtaining Ice Mana Upgrade or Lava Mana Upgrade (which can be found in Igloo’s chest or in Nether chests)

Ice Mana Upgrade R - key

* Gives you ability to walk on water
* Makes 3x3 ice underneath you 
* Ice destroys behind you
* Mana cost: 2.5
* Cooldown: 15 sec
* Duration: 10 sec

Lava Mana Upgrade R - key

* Gives you ability to walk on water
* Makes 3x3 magma underneath you
* Magma destroys behind you
* Mana cost : 2.5
* Cooldown : 15 sec
* Duration : 10 sec

Ice Armor

* Protects you from slows

* Can breathe underwater

* 2 hearths more while in/near water or Snow biome
* Armor is craft able by using ancient ice

Lava Armor

* Protects you from fire

* 2 hearths more while in/near lava or Nether

* Armor is craft able by using ancient magma

Ice Sword

* 10 damage
* -2.4 speed


Ability’s



Left Click/attack


* Slows entities for 0.5 sec

* Entity’s leave snow path for 3 sec

Right Click/ice wind

* Blows ice wind which makes entities:

* Slowed for 1 sec

* Leave snow path

* Next attack deals 1.5 damage more

* Cooldown: 10 sec
* Mana: 2.5 


Lava Sword

* 10 damage
* -2.4 speed

Ability’s

Left Click/attack
* Sets entities on fire for 2 sec

Right Click/fireball

* Throw’s fire ball dealing 4 damage and burning entity for 2 sec

* Targeting entity and next attack deals bonus damage


* Cooldown 10 sec
* Mana: 2.5

Ancient Ice and Ancient Magma
Those are bars used for crafting swords and armor

Join discord to give me ideas, this is not final version of mod.
